subject: ela
intro: Read and pick the main topic or a detail.

items.prompt:
Read.

Dogs can learn tricks. They keep us company.

The main topic is:
A) Dogs
B) Cats
C) Tricks only

steps: All about dogs. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

The ocean has salt water. Fish live in it.

The main topic is:
A) Fish only
B) The ocean
C) Salt

steps: All about the ocean. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The sun gives us light and warmth.

One detail about the sun is:
A) It is cold
B) It gives light
C) It is small

steps: A detail in the text. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

Bears are big. They eat fish and sleep in winter.

The main topic is:
A) Fish
B) Winter
C) Bears

steps: All about bears. Key is C.

items.prompt:
Read.

Firefighters put out fires and help people.

One key detail is:
A) They put out fires
B) They are small
C) They fly

steps: A detail in the text. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

Brushing teeth twice a day keeps them clean.

The main topic is:
A) Food
B) Brushing teeth
C) Sleeping

steps: All about brushing. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

Exercise makes us strong, helps our hearts, and is fun.

The main topic is:
A) Hearts only
B) Exercise
C) Fun games

steps: The whole text is about exercise. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

Elephants are huge, have long trunks, and eat plants.

Which is a detail, NOT the topic?
A) Elephants
B) They have long trunks
C) Animals in general

steps: The topic is elephants; the trunk is a detail. Key is B.
